content_text: Just chiming in on this, I think a must watch is “Road to Perdition”. Conrad Hall’s work in general is always incredible but that film is spectacular when in comes to everything including film language, lighting, composition etc. I’m sure Roger would agree that watching Conrad’s films show how amazing he was.
